headline: Stirling KOs BJP
caption:
Navajo Stirling just knocked out former champ Jiri Prochazka in Doha and stayed perfect at 12-0.
Title shot or one more test? 👇

The UFC Qatar main event ended at 4:58 of round 2, a right hook then ground strikes, Stirling's fourth straight KO and second straight win over a former UFC light heavyweight champion after Jan Blachowicz.

🔥 Hot take: Stirling is the next UFC light heavyweight champion.
Disagree? Tell me why you're wrong.
